summary: Verified /app/web_panel bring-up on the preview URL. All 4 one-click demo logins (Admin, Partner, Customer, Merchant) work end-to-end from /login — no 'Demo login failed' toast, no CORS/network errors. Each role redirects to the correct dashboard. Merchant Scan QR module renders (QR image, merchant name 'Sharma Electricals', ?ref=XZ6SV49 booking link, dl-png button) and PNG download via [data-testid='dl-png'] succeeds (file downloaded: azoapp-poster-XZ6SV49.png). Backend sanity: GET /api/ → 200; GET /api/auth/demo-status → 200 with demo_mode=true and demo accounts including admin/partner/merchant/customer at the expected phone numbers.

minor.issue: SSE endpoint returns errors (page shows repeated failed GETs) but does not affect user-visible functionality; keeps admin page in non-networkidle state.
Intermittent failure observed in one nav; app falls back gracefully (login UI still rendered).

issues: Console warnings 'width(-1) height(-1) of chart' — Recharts container measured 0 during initial paint; cosmetic only.

scan_qr_verification.note: Direct fetch of /api/merchant/panel/qr/poster?fmt=png with localStorage.getItem('token') returned 401 (token stored under different key), but the in-app UI download works, confirming the endpoint is functional via the app's authenticated session.

action_items: Optional: investigate /api/realtime/stream SSE errors and /api/auth/config intermittent failure (non-blocking).
Optional: silence Recharts width/height warnings by giving chart containers explicit min dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: web_panel/.env intentionally leaves REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL empty; api.js falls back to window.location.origin — same-origin /api works via ingress. This is correct for the current preview deployment.
Login.jsx uses data-testid demo-<role> for demo buttons which is testable and consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 demo logins + Scan QR + PNG download)

test_credentials: OTP 123456 for all; +919000000000 admin, +919000000002 merchant, +919000000003 partner, +919000000004 customer (from /api/auth/demo-status).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web panel is served by supervisor program 'webpanel' on :3000; 'frontend' (Expo) is stopped. Login page is at /login. Demo login buttons: [data-testid=demo-{admin|partner|customer|merchant}]. Merchant post-login lands on /merchant with 'Scan QR' side-nav. On dashboards SSE /api/realtime/stream fails and causes networkidle waits to time out — use wait_until='domcontentloaded' in Playwright.
